notes.title: WINTER SALE! Discounts for YOU!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33931355/83839842a854b3e89ecb06c25d02394ee3f69403.png[/img]


Feel free to change your wallpaper to something interesting. This is the best time to download my unique designs at such a low price.


[h1]Hello everyone and we wish you a Happy Holidays and an awesome 2024.[/h1]

My name is Greg and I am the founder of 3DM whose goal was to design and release unique designs as wallpapers on the Steam platform...and we did it. :D

3DM is not a company with offices and a team. 3DM has never had external financial support. I created 3DM as a single person who used my own funds to employ freelancers who coded my crazy ideas for you. I thank them very much for their support.

Despite everything, we managed to publish 14 projects that appeared on many screens around the world. Countless problems, sleepless nights, sweat and tears. Over time, we got better and the designs were improved thanks to the support of players. Thanks to your support. Thank you with all my heart.

As a thank you and on the occasion of the Winter Steam Sale, we are publishing big discounts for those who have just discovered my designs. I highly encourage you to try it and to support the micro developer.

[h3]I wish you a lot of health and joy with your loved ones.[/h3]

[h3]I wish 2024 to be better for everyone![/h3]

[h3]Big love and thanks for support. <brofist>[/h3]

[b]Best wishes,[/b]
Greg 3DM

notes.title: Support 3DM during the Summer Sale.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33931355/bd56238aa89e0e5861abd8f35a7f0d1e1d5c38a3.png[/img]


[h2]Hi All,[/h2]

3DM is a family-owned company that decided to do something different on Steam than everyone else. My little son, the hero for whom I created 3DM, is the driving force.

Interactive wallpapers created on the normal Unity 3D engine turned out to be a bigger problem than we expected. Years of hard work and interesting ideas have allowed full working support for Windows designs as 3D interactive wallpapers.

Investments in good programmers turned out to be the key to success for 3DM to finally start earning money for itself. :)

Unfortunately, some time ago Steam changed the display of programs on the main page, which significantly reduced the reach of 3DM. Imagine, your family business goes down 80% in one day. :(

Nevertheless, we have developed many unique designs that will go down in Steam history as 3DM is the only publisher of 3D interactive wallpapers worldwide. No one else in the world has created continuous 3D interactive wallpapers.

That's why I strongly encourage you to support family 3DM by buying our designs at the Summer Sale. This is a great time to get our designs at a great price.

Thank you for your support!

[h2]Best Regards,[/h2]
[b]3DM Greg[/b]

notes.title: Big System Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33931355/9f8b25d558a41c2ab50a5bce29e178a8d89d3243.jpg[/img]

Big System Update

We have repaired most / all of our wallpaper systems.

Wallpaper design turned out to be something more difficult than we thought. Animated wallpapers for Windows 10 require some system settings. Despite many of our messages, someone still missed them and problems began.

After many tries, it's Big System update is ready. Most problems have probably been fixed.

90% of negative reviews describe what has been fixed:

-I can't control the wallpaper
-I can't turn off the wallpaper
-I can't uninstall this wallpaper
-My menu disappear
-Where is Taskbar to enable the second menu?
-The wallpaper is in window
-False antivirus alert
-Problem with Inputapp.exe process
-3DM website runs on my screen
-Wallpaper won't pause when I start the game
-and more

These problems should be fixed now!

In addition, the new system recognizes if the Windows 10 settings are not correct. After detecting, the wallpaper will automatically change them or show you a video on how to set it. The wallpaper itself will open a window to change the settings to "adjust the best appearance", then click the green "DONE".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33931355/cae73aecef41355cba292522b764ea27aa909939.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33931355/efea90b7df85eb47b84467571d2a7c1534e0d207.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33931355/5847aa56e81504e1bd5d8806a9f51752be4be84a.jpg[/img]


There are more patches but the competition is not sleeping so we will keep them to ourselves.

The user with the correct settings will not see the difference at the beginning but in the end, the project will work much better with it.

We are very pleased that finally, we have created the system with which we are satisfied.

Everything has been tested on many PCs and everything works as it should. If you have any problems, please write below. We will fix immediately.

Some programs may still block our projects, but this is very, very rare.

Please update our project and enjoy!

I would also like to apologize to those who had problems with the settings. Creating wallpaper requires certain technologies but now everything should play.

Thank you also for the support of our users. Your suggestions have helped us a lot and today you can see the effects. Thanks.

Best Regards,

3DM

notes.title: Display Selector is ready!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33931355/ab7f6a2a52f3d22f3f08bd8fcfbdd58eca05dff0.jpg[/img]

Many users with many screens asked for features to select only one screen to display our project. It was our priority to add such a possibility.

[b] It works after a big fight with the Windows code! [/b]

When you start the wallpaper for the first time, a window is displayed where you can select the detected screen. The same function is available in the menu if someone wants to change the screen.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33931355/3f72c3c5444d3e6ae77a492d7e94f927c8c7248f.jpg[/img]

[b][h1]Attention[/h1][/b]

Unfortunately, after this update, you will probably lose your background settings. We are sorry :( :( :(

If you do not see any new features (probably the automatic update is disabled), you should uninstall the wallpaper and reinstall it.

[h1]It's not all.[/h1]

We have added the "Auto Game Mode" which automatically pauses the wallpaper when you turn on the normal game full screen. It automatically gives you 100% of your PC's performance for your favourite games.

The wallpaper recognizes another application / the game is in full-screen mode and then turns off. When you turn off the game, the wallpaper automatically appears on your screens.


[b][h1]Attention[/h1][/b]

Some games do not turn on "real" full-screen mode, so our wallpaper does not turn off. Before you turn on such a game, you need to press the "GAMEMODE" button on the background image itself to get 100% power.

[b] Thank you for your support. Thanks to you, we are constantly developing our projects. [/b]

[i][b] 3DM [/b] [/i]

notes.title: No More False AV Alerts!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33931355/98bad09ea096b1cb36e14a619cd21295b8cd4c5a.jpg[/img]

We are pleased to announce that there will be no problems with fake alerts of some antiviruses which also blocked access to the menu. We've fixed it!

Many users have reported to us or exhibited negative reviews because their anti-virus in connection with Steam and our wallpaper has initiated an alert with something that may be wrong. It also blocked access to the menu by blocking the clicking of the mouse.

Almost all negative reviews are about the problem we just repaired. We wiped the code and created a new one that does not generate any conflicts between Steam and Anti-Virus. We tested it in 70 AV programs and none see the problem :D

There will be no more alerts and blocked menus.
We also added more cameras to this project thanks to which there were even more combinations of amazing views of the planet.

We apologize for the problems and negative reviews. Unfortunately, earlier we did not know how to approach it and even fix it. Now everything will be fine.

A similar patch will be added to our other projects.

Thank you for support!

Have fun :D

3DM

notes.title: FRESH RELEASE
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33931355/071814bbf9c64e8d5ecc831d53969f485f0b036f.jpg[/img]

Thanks to your support at "the Earth" through downloads and positive reviews, we were able to release another project. Thank you for that!

Endless Universe 2 PC Live Wallpaper is a continuation of the mobile version. Here, however, we could afford more and so we give you the shipbuilder so that you can create and explore the infinite universe.

The project has been created over the last months. We have introduced many improvements thanks to our beta testers. Optimization was the most important but we think that we have achieved a good compromise between quality and performance. The system is very efficient so that even older computers should not have problems.

All places visited will be unique so we encourage you to post screenshots of interesting places where they were.
You can add such photos in the Community HUB.

[u]Please send any questions or problems to info@3dmgroup.co.uk[/u]

[b]Thank you for support and we wish you a nice flight![/b]

 
[i]3DM[/i]
